text:
maria: Kickoff — Rapid Proving Ground SI onboarding sprint 🔥. Goal: get 2 SIs through a 2-week runbook + proving kit, cert badge, and marketplace listing ready for pilot. Quick sync Tues 10am? agenda: kit prep, lab access, training plan, announcement window.

sam: Love it. I'll own the runbook (first draft by Fri). Can we confirm hardware partners? who is handling shipping?

lee: I'll coordinate hardware. Partner contacts: CoreEdge (rack 1U test nodes) and NimbusCloud (GPU nodes). Shipping lead is Anya in ops. Need manifest from you, @maria.

maria: Manifest draft here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE (will update). High level: 2x A100 nodes, 1x rtx6000, 1x switch, preloaded container image, ssh key.

jordan: Marketplace launch depends on joint announcement window — we should lock embargo date before training. Ops/legal prefer w/c Apr 12. Is that compatible?

sam: Apr 12 works if runbook and labs are ready by Apr 5. Proposed schedule: draft runbook 3/31, kit packing 4/2, dry-run 4/4.

anya: Shipping note: FedEx 2-day for kits. Need recipient PO and billing. I'll make a packing checklist. Quick snippet for manifest csv:

```
sku,qty,serial,bundle_image
A100-80GB,2,serial-{{sn}},redwood/proving:2026-rc1
RTX-6000,1,serial-{{sn}},redwood/proving:2026-rc1
switch-24p,1,serial-{{sn}},-
```

lee: Also need access instructions for SI engineers — add VPN instructions + jumpbox creds rotation policy to the runbook.

maria: Good call. Sam, can you add a short checklist tab for SI handoff and cert gate (pass criteria)?

sam: Yep. Pass criteria: run 3 evals from repo, 95% success on smoke tests, no critical infra alerts. I'll add step-by-step and links.

jordan: One more: marketing needs 1-page co-sell brief and logo bundle by Apr 6 for embargo prep.

maria: I'll sync with marketing. Final: Tues 10am is confirmed. Calendar invite sent. :thumbsup:

calendar-bot: Event created: 'SI Rapid Proving Ground Kickoff' Tues 10:00 — attendees: maria, sam, lee, jordan, anya.

lee: Thanks — see you then. I'll bring the hardware contact emails.
